Commentary.Commentary: Right, then! We're done with this one. Australia win and go level on points with Pakistan. On Tuesday, 3rd July, the Kangaroos face off against the hosts, and Zimbabwe will have to win, otherwise they risk falling way behind in this tri-series. The action begins at 1000 local (0800 GMT) at this same venue. Do join in then. Cheers!

Australia captain, Aaron Finch, thinks they set the tone with the ball early on which set everything up. Reckons they have been training really well and hence it showed in the performance today. Feels that Jhye Richardson started it off with early wickets and the others bowlers piled on, which is pleasing to see. Is happy with his own effort in the field as he was able to take some good catches. Ends by saying he wants to lead by example so is happy he could fire with the bat.

The Pakistan captain, Sarfraz Ahmed, says losing too many wickets in the first six overs wasn't good. Adds that Billy Stanlake bowled really well, with a lot of bounce and pace, which made it difficult for batters to play him. Concludes by saying that they have plenty to work on and the boys will come back stronger after the break against Zimbabwe.

Alistair Campbell conducts the post-match ceremony. Billy Stanlake, the Man of the Match, starts by saying it was a disappointing tour of the U.K., so they wanted to improve as soon as possible. Adds that the boys have been great and sticking out for each other. Further asserts that his role is to take wickets and make it hard for the opposition to score runs. Also says that bowling four overs on the trot depend on the number of wickets and today, the skipper chose to bowl him out, probably the first time he did it. Ends by praising his captain Aaron Finch's catching and the overall fielding effort by his team.

Much to ponder for the Pakistan camp. They were let down significantly by their batsmen, subsequently putting too much on their bowlers. It can be argued the bowling maybe could have done better, but the asking rate and the brilliance of Finch rendered them handicapped. Mickey Arthur will have a lot to work on with Sarfraz and his boys.

The perfect start for Australia as they begin their journey in this tri-series. First, they did the business with the ball as Billy Stanlake and Andrew Tye did the bulk of the damage, restricting Pakistan to a low score. Then, Aaron Finch finished things off almost all on his own. The early wicket of D'Arcy Short didn't faze him at all. A quickfire 68 with some assistance from Travis Head saw the game ending inside 11 overs. The Men in Yellow will be a happy bunch today.

Dropped and FOUR! And that is it. AUSTRALIA WIN BY 9 WICKETS! Bit of an anti-climatic end to the game, but it's all the same to the Kangaroos. Finch swings and looks to clear wide long on but doesn't have enough height on it. It goes straight to Asif Ali just inside the rope but he drops it. The ball lobs over behind him and rolls across the boundary line.

SIX! Take a bow, Aaron Finch! That is a stupendous hit. Tossed up leg spinner around off, Finch makes room, gets low and smacks it straight back down the ground for a flat maximum. Almost home now, are Australia.
The leg spinner now, it turns back in, Head works it behind square on the leg side and crosses over.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
Googly around off, Head waits for the ball to turn before dabbing it down in front of point for a single.
Slightly fuller around off, Finch walks across and clips it down past short fine leg for a double.

FOUR LEG BYES! The rub of the green, ironically, isn't going Pakistan's way. Usman Khan with a back of a length ball on middle and leg, has nice pace on it and gets Finch on this occasion. Raps him high on the thigh pad as he rises to work it across the line. Loud appeal goes up but the umpire stays unmoved. Now, during all this, the ball has travelled all the way to the third man boundary. So, four bonus runs for Australia.
FOUR! Poor ball. Bad line and he's paid the price for it. Short and down the leg side, the Aussie skipper just helps the pull down the leg side, past short fine leg for a boundary.
Places this on the leg side, through mid-wicket for a run.

A bit of a misfield and that's three runs taken. Fifty for Aaron Finch, his 9th in this format. He swivels and pulls the length ball behind square leg. The man in the deep moves to his right and tries to stop it, but fumbles. The batsmen were going to take two, but then they helped themselves to another one.
Back of a length outside off, Head slices this just wide of sweeper cover for one.
Usman Khan brought back on to roll his arm over.
Flatter and shorter outside off, stays back and keeps it out to covers.
Bit too straight in line, worked away square on the leg side. Single collected by the batsmen.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Pushes this to the cover region and crosses over.
Cracks the punch comfortably through to sweeper cover and changes ends.
Not much spin this time, Travis opens the face slightly and dabs it to point for a run. The 50-run stand is up with that.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Works it around the corner and collects an easy single.
Short and wide outside off, cut away square on the off side for a single.

In the air... but it's safe! Seeing the flight Head gives the charge to go big over the off side. Only skies it over the covers though. Luckily for him in this case, Shoaib Malik from mid off can't get to it in time. Single taken.
Nawaz fires this way down the leg side, Sarfraz can't collect it cleanly. The batsmen take a run as a result.
Worked through the same area again, this time by Travis Head. One run taken.
Sliding in from around the wicket, Finch moves inside the line and works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Mohammad Nawaz comes on to bowl.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single.
Quick and flat outside off, Aaron attempts the cut shot but can't connect.

SIX! He's in a hurry to finish it today. He's not taking any risks as such either. All clean and powerful hits. Full and slow, Finch has no qualms about sending this packing again. Hammers it over long off for another maximum.

SIX! This is even better! Aaron Finch has Shadab's number today. Too full this time and a lot of flight from Shadab, Finch stands tall and sends it sailing deep into the mid-wicket stands for a biggie.

FOUR! The wrong 'un again and Finch has picked it up once again. Looped up, the Australian captain comes forward, kneels down and slog sweeps it through mid-wicket. Beats the man in the deep and picks up a boundary.
Short, flat, it's the leg spinner from the leggie. Aaron hangs back and defends.

Almost a yorker from Hasan, Head jams it out back to the left of the bowler, who dives and stops it. Australia are 60/1 at the end of the Powerplay, compared to Pakistan who were 23/3. Cruising along here.
Brings it in closer to the off stick, on a length, Finch only gets an inside edge onto his pads and takes a quick single as the ball rolls away.
Keeps it in the channel outside off, punched straight to point.

SIX! Aaron Finch at his very best! Hasan Ali pounds it in short, Finch stands tall and with perfect balance, pulls it sweetly over backward square leg for a maximum. Could hold a pose too if he'd like, nobody would complain either.
Slanting across from a good length, Head opens the face slightly and drops it down in front of point to steal a quick one.
Length delivery angling in on middle, Finch attempts to work it on the leg side but it goes off this pads. Leg bye taken.
Googly from Shadab, Finch spots it, picks it up and wrists it to long on for a single.
On the pads, nudged comfortably to short fine leg for one.
Short again, Finch goes back and slaps the pull down towards long on. Was in the air for a bit but it fell short of the fielder there. Single taken.
Short and outside off, punched to the cover area for no run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Tossed right up there, Head makes use of his wrists as he flicks it wide of long on and comes back for the second.
Shadab Khan into the attack. Some spin introduced by Sarfraz Ahmed.
On a length in line of the stumps, blocked down the track for nothing. End of a successful over for Pakistan.
Touch too straight on the hips, Head gets it fine for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length outside off, Head square cuts it through the gap and earns himself a boundary. A nice way to open his account.
Five Wides! Not good from Ali. Errs in line and bowls it wide down the leg side. Safraz behind the wickets dives to his right but can't stop the ball as it races down the fine leg boundary.
Short outside off, Head fails to put bat to ball.
Travis Head walks down to the middle.

OUT! Impact straightaway from Hasan Ali. A fast short ball in line of the stumps, Short goes for the pull but hits it straight to Talat at short mid-wicket. First one is gone, nine more needed if Pakistan have to win this.
Short shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Hasan Ali is comes for a bowl.
FOUR! 4-fours! Now Finchy gets into the act. A back of a length ball around off, Finch gets on his toes and punches it through covers. He beats the fielder and the ball races to the boundary.
A touch short in line of the body, Short pulls it and gets a single from mid-wicket.

FOUR! Third in a row and equally graceful from Short. Usman goes full once again outside off and asks Short to go for the drive who obliges. He goes after it from his crease and pierces the gap between mid off and covers for another boundary.
FOUR! WOW! Another cracker. Usman drags his length back and Short is up for it. He hangs and punches it from his toes. No one moves in the field as the ball goes through covers. A boundary results.
FOUR! Exquisite. Full on a driveable length, Short creams the cover through the gap. He opens his boundary account as well with a beauty.
Short has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

SIX! Another biggie. What a shot. He moves to the leg side to make some room for himself. Nawaz follows him but Finch goes with the shot and hits it into the wide long on stands for another maximum. 15 off the over.

SIX! Smashed. A flighted delivery on middle and off, Finch lines it up and hits through the line. The connection is pure and the ball sails way over the long on fence. First maximum for Finch and Australia.
Pushed through by Nawaz, Short gets behind the line and plays it down the ground for a single.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot for nothing.
Short shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Wide! Down the leg side, wide signalled by the umpire.
Flighted around middle and  off, Finch goes with a cross bat and gets it uppishly to mid-wicket. A run taken.
Mohammad Nawaz to bowl from the other end.

What a beauty from Usman. A length ball pitching outside off and coming in after pitching. Short hangs back in his crease and misses the ball as it raps him on his pads. An appeal follows but the umpire nods his head. The replays shows that the impact might have been outside leg.
A back of a length delivery in line of the stumps, Finch plays it to mid on and scampers for a run.
Full wide outside off, Finch reaches for it and gets bat on it to drive it towards mid off.
Wide! Across the tramline outside off, wide signalled by the umpire.
He's off the mark. Dabs this length ball square in front of point and takes a quick single.
Slightly ahead of a length, on middle and off, defended solidly off the front foot in front of covers.
Fuller and wide outside off, Short looks to smash this through the off side but fails to put bat on ball.

We are back for the chase. Should be a comfortable one for Australia, at least that's what they will feel. D'Arcy Short will take strike and he is partnered by Aaron Finch. Usman Khan to take the ball first up. Here we go...
